An isolated probe of 20 alternating boots (10 base, 10 Q1) reached ready 20/20 in 2.7-3.8 s with no context-loss message (webkit-boot-probe.json). Not a Q1 regression on this evidence; the boot hang is the known WebKit-on-Windows issue (U21) and gives no console text before the timeout

fixAfterVerify.what: Q1 fix after the independent verification (verify/verify-Q1.json): the counters follow the renderer.info and renderer.shadowMap that three.js builds on a WebGL context restore, frames issued while the context is lost are counted apart (lostFrames), the GPU timer is reset on a restore, and the readout says contextLost and counts losses, restores and rebuilds. gpuMs is documented as shadow pass + main pass. Image metrics: railBar (the steel bar alone, canvas rows 551-556) added next to rail; nearForearm renamed nearLeftHand (it is the back of the left hand). Evidence: fix/ (context-restore probes, pixel diff, suites) and serve-*-headless/Q1-c-context-restore-1440x900.json.
